description: This file defines the ContentIndexingService class, which handles indexing of content items within the OrchardCore CMS, including managing content types, culture aspects, and indexing tasks.

classes.name: ContentIndexingService
classes.description: A service class responsible for indexing content items, managing content types, and handling culture-specific indexing within OrchardCore.

methods.name: BeforeProcessingTasksAsync
methods.description: Prepares the indexing context by loading relevant content items and setting up content type filters before processing indexing tasks.

methods.name: GetBuildDocumentIndexAsync
methods.description: Builds the document index for a specific content item based on the indexing task and content metadata.

methods.name: ShouldTrackDocumentAsync
methods.description: Determines whether a content item should be tracked for indexing based on culture and other metadata.
